visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a white t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor food court, holding a large hot dog in a paper wrapper and a blue and black cup. Behind him is a metallic wall with a red 'Emergency Exit' sign and a shopping cart. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) The camera switches to a close-up overhead view of the hot dog. A hand uses a metal dispenser to pile diced white onions onto the sausage. Then, the hand squeezes green relish and yellow mustard from plastic packets onto the onions. (3) Back to the man, he takes a massive bite of the loaded hot dog. As he lifts the blue cup to drink, the dark liquid spills out of the lid, drenching the front of his white t-shirt. He looks shocked and wide-eyed. (4) The scene transitions to an indoor laundry area. The man's hands are shown pouring blue liquid detergent from a large red 'Tide' bottle into the drawer of a silver Panasonic washing machine. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing a 'Before' stained white t-shirt on the left and an 'After' clean white t-shirt on the right. (6) The man stands outdoors in daylight, smiling and holding a red t-shirt and the cleaned white t-shirt on hangers to show they are vibrant and clean. (7) Finally, the man stands in front of a large Costco Wholesale building with a clear blue sky, holding the red Tide bottle and pointing at it enthusiastically.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a Costco food court with metallic walls and emergency exit signs. It moves to a domestic laundry area with a washing machine and a brick wall. It ends in an urban parking lot outside a Costco warehouse building.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy Mandarin male narration begins over an upbeat electronic dance track with a strong 4/4 beat. The speaker is enthusiastic, discussing Costco prices. (2) A sharp 'click' and 'clack' SFX are heard as onion pieces fall, followed by a 'squish' sound for sauce packets. (3) A loud 'crunch' SFX coincides with the man biting the hot dog, followed immediately by a 'gurgle' and 'splash' sound effect as the liquid spills. A comedic 'slump' sound plays. (4) The narration shifts to a more structured, commercial tone as the BGM maintains energy. A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. (5) 'Ding' sounds emphasize the 'Before' and 'After' graphics. (6) The voice-over remains bright and loud, explaining product benefits, ending with a final energetic call to action over the continuing electronic beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Incident -> Solution -> Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'accidental spill' hook during a popular Costco food review to seamlessly transition into an endorsement for Tide OXI laundry detergent, demonstrating its cleaning power and promoting a limited-time discount at Costco.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The second half of the video is a dedicated product demonstration for Tide detergent, including brand close-ups, usage instructions, before/after results, and specific price discount information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The transition from organic food content to a paid advertisement is executed through a situational comedy trope (spilling a drink). The editing is highly optimized for short-form mobile viewing with rapid cuts and bright text overlays.
